title: 第13章 未婚妻先天无垢剑体神秘断剑第14章 倘若是大帝之姿的话似乎也未尝不可
slug: 三天大成了绝世剑仙童养夫
content_zh:
而他所不知道的是，此刻叶天澜的心中也同样是纳闷无比。
直到他已经从所有人面前都路过之后，却依旧没有令气海中那条最为粗壮的气旋发生壮大异变。
“奇了怪了，明明从反应来看对方就在附近，可为什么我从这些人面前路过的时候一个反应都没有呢？”
这几十条普通气旋里面即便是最为粗壮的那一条，也不过只有那条恐怖气龙的万分之一大小而已。
如果换做是以前，叶天澜看见了会很开心，因为这道气旋吐纳元气的效率已经跟叶家两姐妹加起来差不多了。
可在见识到了那条气龙之后，叶天澜表示——
自己从未有过任何一刻像现在这样坚定的选择过一个人！
看见自家孙儿踌躇着站在原地，叶雄风似乎明白了什么，走上前蹲下，轻声问道：
“天儿，这里面没有你喜欢的人吗。”
叶天澜点点头。
此刻的他迫切想要找到那条气龙的源头。
而萧战天则是急了。
没有喜欢的？
这怎么行！
他眼神迅速从几十名女子上扫过，自己孙女儿长得这么漂亮动人，男女老少都通吃，按理来说不应该不会讨这种小孩子的欢喜啊。
可当他视线从众人身上扫过之后，立刻就愣住了。
不信邪的他再次放缓了目光，从头到尾仔仔细细的打量了一个遍。
等等？自己孙女呢？！
怎么没看见人？
之前他都将注意力放在叶天澜身上了，没有关注这些，直到此刻才猛然发现洛珺仙居然根本就没有在这些人之中。

一时之间，他心头不知道应该是庆幸还是着急了。
“等等，叶兄，我孙女有倾国倾城之姿，天儿肯定会满意的，她还没有过来呢。”
似乎是生怕叶雄风反悔，萧战天连忙解释道。
叶雄风脸上升起一丝古怪之色，“你孙女？该不会就是被叶擎空退婚的那少女吧。”
萧战天尴尬的点点头，“是，但你放心，我孙女跟他之间没有任何瓜葛，除了一纸已经被废掉的婚约之外，两人此前甚至连见都没有见过。”
话虽然是这样说，但叶雄风老脸上却依旧是有些犹豫之色。
这···
话虽然是这样说，可说出去终究还是有些落了面子的。
他孙儿可是大帝之姿，他都已经不在乎女方天资了，总得能够拿得出手吧。
况且他王都叶家刚走，自己家就来再续婚约的话，似乎总有一股当了接盘侠的冤大头感···
然而和爷爷的纠结不同，叶天澜瞪大了眼睛，心中瞬间就激动起来了。
神马？
陨落的天才，宗门带人上门退婚，一纸休书？
这岂不是妥妥的主角模板？！
此刻叶天澜心中有一种强烈到爆炸的直觉！
正当叶雄风还在犹豫的时候，却发现叶天澜拉了拉他的裤腿，冲着他点点头。
content_en:
What he didn't know was that Ye Tianlan was also extremely puzzled at this moment.
Even after he passed in front of everyone, he still didn't cause the strongest cyclone in the air sea to change in size.
"It's strange. It's obvious from the reaction that the other party is nearby, but why didn't there be any reaction when I passed by these people?"
Even the thickest one among these dozens of ordinary cyclones is only one ten thousandth of the size of that terrifying air dragon.
If it had been in the past, Ye Tianlan would have been very happy when he saw it, because the efficiency of this cyclone in absorbing vitality was almost the same as that of the two sisters of the Ye family combined.
But after seeing the air dragon, Ye Tianlan said——
I have never chosen someone as firmly as I do now!
Seeing his grandson standing hesitantly, Ye Xiongfeng seemed to understand something. He walked forward, squatted down, and asked softly:
"Tian'er, isn't there anyone you like here?"
Ye Tianlan nodded.
At this moment, he desperately wanted to find the source of the air dragon.
Xiao Zhantian, on the other hand, was anxious.
Don't like anything?
How can this work!
His eyes quickly glanced at dozens of women. His granddaughter was so beautiful and attractive that all men, women and children would like her. Logically speaking, she should not be able to please such a child.
But when his eyes swept over everyone, he was immediately stunned.
Not believing in evil, he slowed down his gaze again and looked at it carefully from beginning to end.
etc? Where is your granddaughter? !
Why didn't you see anyone?
He had focused on Ye Tianlan before, not paying attention to these things. Only now did he suddenly realize that Luo Junxian was not among these people at all.
For a moment, he didn't know whether he should be happy or anxious.
"Wait a minute, Brother Ye, Tian'er will definitely be satisfied with my granddaughter's appearance. She has not come here yet."
As if afraid that Ye Xiongfeng would regret it, Xiao Zhantian quickly explained.
A strange look appeared on Ye Xiongfeng's face, "Your granddaughter? Could it be the girl whose engagement was broken off by Ye Qingkong?"
Xiao Zhantian nodded awkwardly, "Yes, but don't worry, my granddaughter has nothing to do with him. Except for a marriage contract that has been annulled, the two have never even met before."
Although he said this, there was still some hesitation on Ye Xiongfeng's old face.
This...
Even though he said this, he still felt a little embarrassed after saying it out loud.
His grandson is like a great emperor, he no longer cares about the woman's talent, he must be able to use it.
Moreover, if the Ye family of his royal capital comes to renew the engagement just after leaving the royal capital, there always seems to be a sense of being taken advantage of...
However, unlike his grandfather's entanglement, Ye Tianlan's eyes widened and his heart suddenly became excited.
What a horse?
A fallen genius, the sect brought someone to his door to break off the engagement, and a divorce letter?
Isn’t this a perfect protagonist template? !
At this moment, Ye Tianlan had an explosive intuition in his heart!
Just when Ye Xiongfeng was still hesitating, he found that Ye Tianlan pulled his trouser leg and nodded at him.
